story.title: Railway station
paragraphs_en: Sudhir, Arvind, Geeta and Ravi were chatting while relaxing after long evening games. They all were between 9 -12 yrs of age group. Sudhir was the eldest and Ravi was the youngest. "Let us go to railway station tomorrow ," Sudhir asked. All agreed readily and were excited to go. They said in one ," Sure, we have not gone that side since long. Mango, tamarind and berries trees might have laden with fruit by now." Ravi said," We will take slingshot too this time." Geeta was sitting quiet.

Sudhir asked Geeta," Will you go?" " No, Not at all. Last time , mother scolded me severely," said Geeta. " That day, we got late while returning," Sudhir clarified the situation. " This time, we will go on cycles and also early morning," Ravi suggested. Second day, All the four started on their cycles to railway station at 10 am. There was one railway line , crossing the road, 3 Km. far from city west.

It was gated. On other side of track, there was a village area. The area was laden with fields, grounds,and gardens. The fruit laden trees were special attraction for these children. All the four were moving ahead slowly and steadily. All of the sudden, Sudhir suggested ," let us have a race." Ravi said,' Up to where?" Sudhir pointed towards a well situated on left side of the road which was only 200 mt. away.

" Ok!", All were ready. sudhir asked every one to stop. All put their foot down. One tractor was crossing the road. They allowed it to pass. There was no rush on that road. After tractor, the whole road was deserted. All the four, got set on cycles and moved ahead with a competitive spirit. Geeta stood first. She was the one who reached well first. A little later, all reached. All congratulated her. Geeta said," I have won the race.

What prize I will get?" On this Arvind said," Really, we should have kept some bet." Ravi said," No, It is not good to bet." After listening opinions of all, Sudhir suggested," Geeta can take as many tamarind pods out of total stock we will pluck." Geeta's mouth was watered by name of tamarind. she said laughingly, " What if I want to take all!" Sudhir said pampering her," You can take it. Let us have some water first.

I am very thirsty." Sudhir was the eldest of all and strong too. He was like a group leader. All agreed him. There was a bucket and rope near the well. Sudhir filled the bucket with water. All quenched their thirst. They all started ahead towards railway station. It was now not too far. They reached near railway gate. The gate was open. They all put their feet down and crossed the railway lines carefully.

The area was deserted. Only one or two farmers were at work in their field. Three four laborers were busy in repairing the track. Geeta noticed that they were four boys wearing blue jeans and black T-shirts. They had covered their mouth and head with black cloth. This was all very fishy. She moved ahead with all. They all reached their destination. There was a gram field on left side of the road. On its boundary, there were Tamarind and guava trees.

The tamarind tree was huge and shady. All the children gathered under this tree. All parked their cycles with support of its stem. Children took out their sling shots. A small pebble was fixed in between. They saw that farmer was busy in his task at a distance. Sudhir advised all to stand in one direction and to shoot in other direction. This way , accidental hurt could be avoided. All stood beside him. All shot perfectly at tamarind bunches.

Some birds were sitting on the trees. They flew high in the sky with the sound of shot. Many tamarind bunches also fell down on the ground. On hearing birds cacophony , the farmer got alert.He took a pause for a moment, glanced towards tree and got busy again with his task. Children gathered tamarind pods and tied in handkerchief. They got ample pods in one go. They hanged this bundle in one cycle handle and moved towards guava tree. Guava tree was few steps away from tamarind tree.

Geeta was walking ahead of all. She was very fond of climbing tree. Luckily, guava tree was not so high. She was of firm opinion that she would climb easily on the tree and pluck guavas and throw down on the ground. Raw or ripe guavas could be easily identified even from the distance. Otherwise too, it hardly mattered to them if tamarind or guava were raw or ripe. It was a great fun to pluck fruit from the tree and eat it. Moreover, it was their hard earned fruit, hence, everything was tasty.

As soon as they reached near guava tree, they heard train whistle. Out of curiosity, they turned their faces towards railway track to see the train. One strange thing happened. All were attracted towards it. The four boys started running towards field. Geeta clearly identified them.She uttered," They are same boys who were repairing the track. why they are fleeing like this? Something serious is there!"

With a second thought, Geeta shouted," Hurry up!" On saying this, she ran toward track.. Sudhir,Ravi and Arvind too ran after her. Geeta escorted them at the spot where those boys were pretending to repair. When they reached there, they saw track was broken. They were shocked to see. They were children but were not fool. They understood the seriousness of the situation. They could foresee the damage and havoc it would create once train passed over it.

Geeta saw that Ravi was wearing red shirt.She asked Ravi," Hurry up! Take out your shirt and give it to me." Ravi followed her instructions. They could hear another whistle now. The train was also visible at a distance. Geeta started trembling. She knew that hundreds Of people life is at risk. She clinched Ravi,s shirt and ran towards train coming while waving the shirt high. Sudhir,Ravi and Arvind too ran after Geeta. After a short distance, Geeta stopped her feet. All the three too stopped.

﻿Sudhir and Arvind too took out their shirts and started waving high in air. The train was coming nearer and nearer.The sound was becoming clearer and loud. The engine was also looking clear and huge. All were terrified and shaken. They were just waving their shirts standing on the spot. They also started shouting now," Stop! Stop the train." No doubt, engine driver could not hear their voice amidst loud sound of engine. The only possibility to stop the train was that engine driver might see some movement on the track. And Lo! Perhaps he has seen it.

The train halted with a horn at safe distance from children . Engine driver came running towards children. He asked." What happened? Why are you standing like this on the track? " Geeta replied," Uncle, There is a danger ahead. The tracks are broken. We did this only to stop the train." " Where is it? Let us see.," said driver. Geeta and friends guided him towards the spot.

" Oh God! This is really dangerous. A big accident could happen. You all have done a wonderful and brave act to stop the train." Meanwhile, the guard and some passengers too reached on the spot. The guard informed the matter on phone to police and senior officials. Geeta returned Ravi shirt to wear . Sudhir and Arvind too put on their shirts.

Geeta and her friends wanted to go back their homes. As soon as they were ready to depart, guard uncle said," Children , you need to wait for a while till police reaches here. You are required to explain the incident fully. You can wait in my train compartment, if you desire so. " Sudhir replied, "No uncle , we are comfortable here only." All children too agreed with Sudhir. After a while, railway officials, photographer, police and journalists reached on the site. Sudhir was worried about cycles. And Geeta was feeling hungry.

Now they were missing their tamarind pods and guavas. Arvind was in apprehension of rebuke he had to face on reaching home. Because they were getting late. Ravi was fearful of police in general. One police inspector asked their names and addresses and noted down in dairy along with full description of incident. The photographer took their photo too. The police inspector asked Geeta," How you will go to your home?"

Geeta said," We have our cycles. These are parked nearby." " Should they be allowed to go , Sir?", asked inspector to police official. He said," Yes! Let them go." He himself came near to children. He praised them for their bravery. " Bravo! You have done a noble act. You can go now." Geeta said," Thank you, uncle." All friends too repeated," Thank you, uncle."

They all moved fast towards their cycles. They distributed tamarind pods hurriedly. Every one stuffed their pockets and started their ride on cycle towards their homes. They did not tell anything about this incident at home out of fear. Next day, each local newspaper covered the railway station incident with their photographs. They all were highly praised . It leaked out all the secret of going to railway station. Elders in each home were angry and rebuked them.
They were angry because they went so far without telling anybody at home. At the same time , they were praised and encouraged for their bravery. It has saved so many lives.

items.text_en: Sudhir, Arvind, Geeta and Ravi were chatting while relaxing after long evening games.
They all were between 9 -12 yrs of age group.
Sudhir was the eldest and Ravi was the youngest.
"Let us go to railway station tomorrow ," Sudhir asked.
All agreed readily and were excited to go.
They said in one ," Sure, we have not gone that side since long.
Mango, tamarind and berries trees might have laden with fruit by now." Ravi said," We will take slingshot too this time." Geeta was sitting quiet.
Sudhir asked Geeta," Will you go?" " No, Not at all.
Last time , mother scolded me severely," said Geeta.
" That day, we got late while returning," Sudhir clarified the situation.
" This time, we will go on cycles and also early morning," Ravi suggested.
Second day, All the four started on their cycles to railway station at 10 am.
There was one railway line , crossing the road, 3 Km.
far from city west.
It was gated.
On other side of track, there was a village area.
The area was laden with fields, grounds,and gardens.
The fruit laden trees were special attraction for these children.
All the four were moving ahead slowly and steadily.
All of the sudden, Sudhir suggested ," let us have a race." Ravi said,' Up to where?" Sudhir pointed towards a well situated on left side of the road which was only 200 mt. away.
" Ok!", All were ready.
sudhir asked every one to stop.
All put their foot down.
One tractor was crossing the road.
They allowed it to pass.
There was no rush on that road.
After tractor, the whole road was deserted.
All the four, got set on cycles and moved ahead with a competitive spirit.
Geeta stood first.
She was the one who reached well first.
A little later, all reached.
All congratulated her.
Geeta said," I have won the race.

What prize I will get?" On this Arvind said," Really, we should have kept some bet." Ravi said," No, It is not good to bet." After listening opinions of all, Sudhir suggested," Geeta can take as many tamarind pods out of total stock we will pluck." Geeta's mouth was watered by name of tamarind.
she said laughingly, " What if I want to take all!" Sudhir said pampering her," You can take it.
Let us have some water first.
I am very thirsty." Sudhir was the eldest of all and strong too.
He was like a group leader.
All agreed him.
There was a bucket and rope near the well.
Sudhir filled the bucket with water.
All quenched their thirst.
They all started ahead towards railway station.
It was now not too far.
They reached near railway gate.
The gate was open.
They all put their feet down and crossed the railway lines carefully.
The area was deserted.
Only one or two farmers were at work in their field.
Three four laborers were busy in repairing the track.
Geeta noticed that they were four boys wearing blue jeans and black T-shirts.
They had covered their mouth and head with black cloth.
This was all very fishy.
She moved ahead with all.
They all reached their destination.
There was a gram field on left side of the road.
On its boundary, there were Tamarind and guava trees.
The tamarind tree was huge and shady.
